# README.md

Source: https://github.com/ovidijusparsiunas/active-table/blob/main/README.md

<br />

![alt text](./assets/readme/title.png)

<b>Active Table</b> is a fully customizable web component built with a focus on delivering the best editable table experience possible. Whether you need a simple table or a complex real-time data visualization grid, this component can be tailored to suit your specific needs! Explore [activetable.io](https://activetable.io/) to view all of the available features, how to use them, examples and more!

### :rocket: Main Features

- Add/Remove/Move/Edit rows/columns
- Text validation
- Sorting
- Pagination
- Filtering
- Column types: Text/Number/Currency/Select/Label/Date/Checkbox
- API for building custom column types
- Import/Export/Paste/Drag&Drop csv, xls, xlsx, ods, txt files
- Programmatic cell updates
- Reactive dimensions
- Overflow handling
- Everything is customizable!

### :tada: Latest update

Table [columns](https://activetable.io/docs/column#dragColumns) and [rows](https://activetable.io/docs/row#dragRows) can now be dragged using your mouse:

<p align="center">
    <img width="650" src="https://github.com/OvidijusParsiunas/active-table/assets/18709577/22095883-8beb-4be6-a75a-61beab3d6ea7" alt="Drag Feature">
</p>

### :computer: Getting started

```
npm install active-table
```

If using React, install the following instead:

```
npm install active-table-react
```

Then simply add this to your markup:

```
<active-table data='[["Planet", "Diameter"], ["Earth", 12756]]'/>
```

The exact syntax for the above example will vary depending on the framework of your choice ([see here](https://activetable.io/examples/frameworks)).

Check out the live codepen examples for your [UI framework/library](https://activetable.io/examples/frameworks) of choice:

# Column

# Column

Properties related to table columns.

### `customColumnsSettings` {#customColumnsSettings}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `headerName: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`defaultColumnTypeName?: string`](/docs/columnType#defaultColumnTypeName), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`availableDefaultColumnTypes?: DEFAULT_COLUMN_TYPES[]`](/docs/columnType#availableDefaultColumnTypes), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`customColumnTypes?: ColumnType[]`](/docs/columnType#customColumnTypes), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`defaultText?: string|number`](/docs/data#defaultText), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`isDefaultTextRemovable?: boolean`](/docs/data#isDefaultTextRemovable), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`cellStyle?: cellStyle`](/docs/data#cellStyle), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`isCellTextEditable?: boolean`](/docs/data#isCellTextEditable), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`isColumnResizable?: boolean`](#isColumnResizable), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`headerStyles?: headerStyles`](/docs/header#headerStyles), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`isHeaderTextEditable?: boolean`](/docs/header#isHeaderTextEditable), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`headerIconStyle?: HeaderIconStyle`](/docs/header#HeaderIconStyle), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`columnDropdown?: ColumnDropdownSettings`](#ColumnDropdownSettings) <br />
  }[]

Array of custom properties for columns with header text that matches the `headerName`. Values for properties that are not set will
automatically be inherited from the corresponding component level properties (except `headerName`).

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    customColumnsSettings={[
      {headerName: 'Planet', defaultText: 'Insert Planet', cellStyle: {width: '150px'}, isHeaderTextEditable: false},
      {
        headerName: 'Number',
        cellStyle: {backgroundColor: '#fdfdfd'},
        defaultColumnTypeName: 'number',
        isHeaderTextEditable: false,
      },
      {
        headerName: 'Shape',
        cellStyle: {backgroundColor: '#f8f8f8'},
        defaultColumnTypeName: 'Select',
        isHeaderTextEditable: false,
      },
      {
        headerName: 'Date Created',
        cellStyle: {backgroundColor: '#f1f1f1'},
        defaultColumnTypeName: 'Date d-m-y',
        isHeaderTextEditable: false,
      },
      ['Planet', 'Number', 'Shape', 'Date Created'],
      ['', 12756, 'Sphere', '01-02-2012'],
      ['', 6792, 'Dinosaur', '14-05-1990'],
      ['', 142984, 'Triangle', '04-12-2020'],
      ['', 120536, 'Square', '23-10-2008'],
      ['', 49528, 'Flat', '19-02-2006'],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnsSettings='[
    { "headerName": "Planet", "defaultText": "Insert Planet", "cellStyle": {"width": "150px"}, "isHeaderTextEditable": false },
    { "headerName": "Number", "cellStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#fdfdfd"}, "defaultColumnTypeName": "number", "isHeaderTextEditable": false },
    { "headerName": "Shape", "cellStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#f8f8f8"}, "defaultColumnTypeName": "Select", "isHeaderTextEditable": false },
    { "headerName": "Date Created", "cellStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#f1f1f1"}, "defaultColumnTypeName": "Date d-m-y", "isHeaderTextEditable": false }
  ]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnsSettings='[
    { "headerName": "Planet", "defaultText": "Insert Planet", "cellStyle": {"width": "150px"}, "isHeaderTextEditable": false },
    { "headerName": "Number", "cellStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#fdfdfd"}, "defaultColumnTypeName": "number", "isHeaderTextEditable": false },
    { "headerName": "Shape", "cellStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#f8f8f8"}, "defaultColumnTypeName": "Select", "isHeaderTextEditable": false },
    { "headerName": "Date Created", "cellStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#f1f1f1"}, "defaultColumnTypeName": "Date d-m-y", "isHeaderTextEditable": false }
  ]'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Number", "Shape", "Date Created"],
    ["", 12756, "Sphere", "01-02-2012"],
    ["", 6792, "Dinosaur", "14-05-1990"],
    ["", 142984, "Triangle", "04-12-2020"],
    ["", 120536, "Square", "23-10-2008"],
    ["", 49528, "Flat", "19-02-2006"]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `isColumnResizable` {#isColumnResizable}

- Type: `boolean`
- Default: _true_

Determines if columns can be resized via the use of the overlay between header cells. When `width` is defined in [`cellStyle`](/docs/data#cellStyle)
and [`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle) properties, and this is set to _true_ - the column `width` will be automatically overwritten to
meet the set table `width`. However if this is set to _false_, columns will permanently hold the initially set `width`.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    isColumnResizable={true}

```html
<active-table isColumnResizable="true"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  isColumnResizable="true"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `columnResizerColors` {#columnResizerColors}

- Type: { `hover?: string`, `click?: string` }
- Default: { _hover: #808080_, _click: #4668ed_ }

Column width resizer overlay background color style for hover and click events.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    columnResizerColors={{hover: '#87ddff', click: '#369cfd'}}

```html
<active-table columnResizerColors='{ "hover": "#87ddff", "click": "#369cfd" }'></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  columnResizerColors='{ "hover": "#87ddff", "click": "#369cfd" }'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `columnDropdown` {#columnDropdown}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[`displaySettings?: DropdownDisplaySettings`](/docs/sharedTypes#DropdownDisplaySettings), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[`ColumnDropdownSettings`](#ColumnDropdownSettings) <br />
  } <br />
- Default: {<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _displaySettings: {isAvailable: true, openMethod: {cellClick: true}}_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isSortAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isDeleteAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isInsertLeftAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isInsertRightAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isMoveAvailable: true_ <br />

Settings for the column dropdown. If `displaySettings` object's `openMethod` property has `cellClick` set to _true_ - open the dropdown by clicking
on the header cell. If `openMethod` has `overlayClick` set to _true_ - hover over the header cell, then click on the overlay component that will
appear over it.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    columnDropdown={{
      displaySettings: {
        openMethod: {overlayClick: true},
      },
      isSortAvailable: false,
      isMoveAvailable: false,
    }}

```html
<active-table
  columnDropdown='{
    "displaySettings": {
      "openMethod": {"overlayClick": true}},
    "isSortAvailable": false,
    "isMoveAvailable": false
  }'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  columnDropdown='{
    "displaySettings": {
      "openMethod": {"overlayClick": true}},
    "isSortAvailable": false,
    "isMoveAvailable": false
  }'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `maxColumns` {#maxColumns}

- Type: `number`
- Default: _unset_

Maximum number of columns allowed (not including the index and add columns column).

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    maxColumns={4}

```html
<active-table maxColumns="4"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  maxColumns="4"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `dragColumns` {#dragColumns}

- Type: `boolean`
- Default: _true_

Toggles the ability to change column positions by dragging header cells or their overlays with your mouse. <br />

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    dragColumns={true}

```html
<active-table dragColumns="true"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  dragColumns="true"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `preserveNarrowColumns` {#preserveNarrowColumns}

- Type: `boolean`
- Default: _true_

When [`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle) is set with a `width` or `maxWidth` property to limit its size, the insertion of new columns will
cause all existing column widths to automatically be reduced to make space for the new ones (except columns set with `isColumnResizable` as _false_
inside [`cellStyle`](/docs/data#cellStyle) of the [`customColumnsSettings`](#customColumnsSettings) object). This can however become problematic when
existing column widths eventually become too narrow\* and their widths cannot be reduced any further. <br />
When `preserveNarrowColumns` is _true_ and column widths are too narrow\*, the table width will be increased to allow new columns to be inserted. <br />
When `preserveNarrowColumns` is _false_ and column widths are too narow\*, no new columns will be allowed to be inserted.
set to true by default.<br />
_\*Minimal column size is recognised as 33px_

**Example where preset table width of 300px is exceeded**

<TableContainer minHeight="189">
      [
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
      ],
      [
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
        '1',
        '2',
      ],
    tableStyle={{width: '300px', boxShadow: 'rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px', borderRadius: '2px'}}

```html
<active-table
  preserveNarrowColumns="true"
  tableStyle='{"width":"300px"}'
  data='[
    ["1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2"],
    ["1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2"]]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  data='[
      ["1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2"],
      ["1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2","1","2"]]'
  tableStyle='{"width":"300px", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

:::info
Please note that when [`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle) contains a `width` or `maxWidth` property with a _%_ or _vw_ unit and the window width is changed - if columns
cannot be reduced any further the excess ones will not be removed even if `preserveNarrowColumns` is set to _false_ to prevent loss of data.

### `displayAddNewColumn` {#displayAddNewColumn}

- Type: `boolean`
- Default: _true_

A toggle for a clickable '+' column on the right which is used to add new empty columns. <br />
You can set the add new column style via [`frameComponentsStyles`](/docs/table#frameComponentsStyles).

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    displayAddNewColumn={true}

```html
<active-table displayAddNewColumn="true"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  displayAddNewColumn="true"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `displayIndexColumn` {#displayIndexColumn}

- Type: `boolean` | {`wrapIndexCellText: boolean`}
- Default: _{wrapIndexCellText: false }_

A toggle for the index column on the left. <br />
When `wrapIndexCellText` is set to _true_, the index column width will be static and any overflowing digits inside its cells will be wrapped within its boundaries. This is
useful in a scenario where `width`/`maxWidth` is set within [`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle) and the addition of any more columns would cause the width to be breached
due to all columns having the mimimal width of _33px_. Hence by keeping index column width narrow - more columns can be added without breaching the set `width`/`maxWidth`.
If `wrapIndexCellText` is set to _false_ and [`preserveNarrowColumns`](#preserveNarrowColumns) is set to _true_ - if the table width is also about to be breached,
`wrapIndexCellText` will be automatically set to _true_ and the index width will be set back to the initial width. <br />
You can set the index column style via [`frameComponentsStyles`](/docs/table#frameComponentsStyles).

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    displayIndexColumn={{wrapIndexCellText: false}}

```html
<active-table displayIndexColumn='{"wrapIndexCellText": false}'></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  displayIndexColumn='{"wrapIndexCellText": false}'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

:::note
If [`dataStartsAtHeader`](/docs/header#dataStartsAtHeader) is _true_, the index count will start from the header row, otherwise it will start from the first data row. <br />
:::note
Please note that cell unwrapping detection is not supported and once the index column is wrapped via `wrapIndexCellText` it will stay in this
form for the rest of the session.

## Types

Shared object property types related to columns:

### `ColumnDropdownSettings` {#ColumnDropdownSettings}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`isSortAvailable?: boolean`,<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`isDeleteAvailable?: boolean`,<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`isInsertLeftAvailable?: boolean`,<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`isInsertRightAvailable?: boolean`,<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`isMoveAvailable?: boolean`<br />
- Default: {<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isSortAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isDeleteAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isInsertLeftAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isInsertRightAvailable: true_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _isMoveAvailable: true_ <br />

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    columnDropdown={{
      isSortAvailable: false,
      isDeleteAvailable: true,
      isInsertLeftAvailable: false,
      isInsertRightAvailable: true,
    }}

```html
<active-table
  columnDropdown='{
    "isSortAvailable": false,
    "isDeleteAvailable": true,
    "isInsertLeftAvailable": false,
    "isInsertRightAvailable": true
  }'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  columnDropdown='{
    "isSortAvailable": false,
    "isDeleteAvailable": true,
    "isInsertLeftAvailable": false,
    "isInsertRightAvailable": true
  }'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

# Column Type

Source: https://github.com/ovidijusparsiunas/active-table/blob/main/website/docs/docs/columnType.mdx

sidebar_position: 7

# Column Type

Properties related to column types.

### `defaultColumnTypeName` {#defaultColumnTypeName}

- Type: `string`
- Default: _First available type to not have validation -> First available type -> "Text"_

Name for the default column type.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Label'}

```html
<active-table defaultColumnTypeName="Label"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  defaultColumnTypeName="Label"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `availableDefaultColumnTypes` {#availableDefaultColumnTypes}

- Type: [`DEFAULT_COLUMN_TYPES[]`](#DEFAULT_COLUMN_TYPES)
- Default: _["Text", "Number", "Currency", "Date d-m-y", "Date m-d-y", "Checkbox", "Select", "Label"]_

Used to overwrite the available default column types. If array is set to empty (_[]_) and there are no [`customColumnTypes`](#customColumnTypes), the default type
will be automatically set to _"Text"_.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    availableDefaultColumnTypes={['Number']}
      ['1', 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ['2', 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ['3', 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      ['4', 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      ['5', 49528, 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table availableDefaultColumnTypes='["Number"]'></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  availableDefaultColumnTypes='["Number"]'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["1", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["2", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["3", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["4", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["5", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `customColumnTypes` {#customColumnTypes}

- Type: [`ColumnType[]`](#ColumnType)
- Default: _[]_

An array of custom column types which are automatically appended to the [`availableDefaultColumnTypes`](#availableDefaultColumnTypes) types array.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    availableDefaultColumnTypes={[]}
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom type',
        select: {
          options: ['Pass', 'Fail'],
          canAddMoreOptions: false,
        },
        iconSettings: {
          reusableIconName: 'select',
        },
      },
      ['Category 1', 'Category 2', 'Category 3', 'Category 4', 'Category 5'],
      ['Pass', 'Pass', 'Fail', 'Fail', 'Fail'],
      ['Fail', 'Pass', 'Pass', 'Fail', 'Fail'],
      ['Fail', 'Pass', 'Pass', 'Pass', 'Fail'],
      ['Pass', 'Fail', 'Fail', 'Pass', 'Pass'],
      ['Pass', 'Fail', 'Fail', 'Fail', 'Fail'],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[{
    "name": "Custom type",
    "select": {
      "options": ["Pass", "Fail"],
      "canAddMoreOptions": false
    },
    "iconSettings": {
      "reusableIconName": "select"
    }}]'
  availableDefaultColumnTypes="[]"
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[{
    "name": "Custom type",
    "select": {
      "options": ["Pass", "Fail"],
      "canAddMoreOptions": false
    },
    "iconSettings": {
      "reusableIconName": "select"
    }}]'
  availableDefaultColumnTypes="[]"
  data='[
    ["Category 1", "Category 2", "Category 3", "Category 4", "Category 5"],
    ["Pass", "Pass", "Fail", "Fail", "Fail"],
    ["Fail", "Pass", "Pass", "Fail", "Fail"],
    ["Fail", "Pass", "Pass", "Pass", "Fail"],
    ["Pass", "Fail", "Fail", "Pass", "Pass"],
    ["Pass", "Fail", "Fail", "Fail", "Fail"]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

## Types

Shared object property types related to column types:

### `ColumnType` {#ColumnType}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `name: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`textValidation?: TextValidation`](#TextValidation), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`customTextProcessing?: CustomTextProcessing`](#CustomTextProcessing), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`sorting?: Sorting`](#Sorting), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`iconSettings?: IconSettings`](#IconSettings), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`select?: boolean|CellDropdown<SelectOptions>`](#CellDropdown), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`label?: boolean|CellDropdown<LabelOptions>`](#CellDropdown), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`calendar?: Calendar`](#Calendar), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`checkbox?: Checkbox`](#Checkbox) <br />

- Default: {<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _sorting: in the ASCII character order ("Text" type)_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; _dropdownIconSettings: using "Text" type icon _<br />

Details for creating a column type. <br />
If [`textValidation`](#TextValidation) and [`customTextProcessing`](#CustomTextProcessing) are both provided, [`customTextProcessing`](#CustomTextProcessing) will be executed first. <br />
The [`select`](#CellDropdown), [`label`](#CellDropdown), [`calendar`](#Calendar) and [`checkbox`](#Checkbox) properties facilitate unique features and if
more than one of these is provided - only the first one will be used in that order.

### `TextValidation` {#TextValidation}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `func: (cellText: string) => boolean`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `setTextToDefaultOnFail?: boolean`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`failedStyle?: NoDimensionCSSStyle`](/docs/sharedTypes#NoDimensionCSSStyle), <br />
- Default: { _setTextToDefaultOnFail: true_ }

Used to enforce cell text validation. This operates only in the data cells and not the header. <br />
The `func` property takes a function that will be called when the text is initially placed in the cell and when
it changes. The function must return _true_ if the text is correct or _false_ if it is incorrect.
`setTextToDefaultOnFail` will reset the cell text to value defined inside [`defaultText`](/docs/data#defaultText)
if the function returns _false_. <br />
`failedStyle` is used to change the cell styling if the function returns _false_.

#### Example validation for if number is higher than 20

<TableContainer>
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom type',
        textValidation: {
          func: '(cellText) => Number(cellText) > 20',
          setTextToDefaultOnFail: false,
          failedStyle: {color: 'red'},
        },
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom type'}
      ['Gravity', 'Diameter', 'Mass', 'Moons', 'Density'],
      [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom type",
      "textValidation": {
        "func": "(cellText) => Number(cellText) > 20",
        "setTextToDefaultOnFail":false,
        "failedStyle":{"color":"red"}
  }}]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom type",
      "textValidation": {
        "func": "(cellText) => Number(cellText) > 20",
        "setTextToDefaultOnFail":false,
        "failedStyle":{"color":"red"}
  }}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom type"
  data='[
    ["Gravity", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `CustomTextProcessing` {#CustomTextProcessing}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `changeTextFunc?: (cellText: string, rowIndex: number) => string|number`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`changeStyleFunc?: (cellText: string, rowIndex: number) => NoDimensionCSSStyle`](/docs/sharedTypes#NoDimensionCSSStyle), <br />

Augments cell after its text is changed. `changeTextFunc` is a function that processes cell text and
returns same/new text depending on its contents. `changeStyleFunc` is a function that processes cell text and
returns a styling object for the cell depenging on its contents.

#### Example processing for currency: 20 (red) < 100 (yellow) < more (green)

<TableContainer>
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom type',
        customTextProcessing: {
          changeTextFunc: '(cellText) => `$${Number(cellText.replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g,""))}`',
          changeStyleFunc:
            '(cellText) => {' +
            'const moneyNumber = Number(cellText.replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g,""));' +
            'if (moneyNumber < 20) return {backgroundColor: `#ff3232`};' +
            'if (moneyNumber < 100) return {backgroundColor: `#ffff00`};' +
            'return {backgroundColor: `#00ac00`};' +
            '}',
        },
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom type'}
      ['Gravity', 'Diameter', 'Mass', 'Moons', 'Density'],
      [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
  {
    "name": "Custom type",
    "customTextProcessing": {
      "changeTextFunc": "(cellText) => `$${Number(cellText.replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g,\"\"))}`",
      "changeStyleFunc": "(cellText) => {
        const moneyNumber = Number(cellText.replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g,\"\"));
        if (moneyNumber < 20) return {backgroundColor: `#ff3232`};
        if (moneyNumber < 100) return {backgroundColor: `#ffff00`};
        return {backgroundColor: `#00ac00`};
      }"
  }}]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
  {
    "name": "Custom type",
    "customTextProcessing": {
      "changeTextFunc": "(cellText) => `$${Number(cellText.replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g,\"\"))}`",
      "changeStyleFunc": "(cellText) => {
        const moneyNumber = Number(cellText.replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g,\"\"));
        if (moneyNumber < 20) return {backgroundColor: `#ff3232`};
        if (moneyNumber < 100) return {backgroundColor: `#ffff00`};
        return {backgroundColor: `#00ac00`};
      }"
  }}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom type"
  data='[
    ["Gravity", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `Sorting` {#Sorting}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `ascendingFunc: (cellText1: string, cellText2: string) => number`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `descendingFunc: (cellText1: string, cellText2: string) => number`, <br />

Facilitates column cell sorting capabilities.
The functions are executed using the standard JavaScript [.sort](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/sort)
method and are expected to return a negative value (< 0) if cellText1 is less than cellText2, zero (0) if both arguments
are equal, or a positive value (> 0) if cellText1 is greater than cellText2.

#### Example sorting for numbers

<TableContainer>
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom type',
        sorting: {
          ascendingFunc: '(cellText1, cellText2) => Number(cellText1) - Number(cellText2)',
          descendingFunc: '(cellText1, cellText2) => Number(cellText2) - Number(cellText1)',
        },
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom type'}
      ['Gravity', 'Diameter', 'Mass', 'Moons', 'Density'],
      [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom type",
      "sorting": {
        "ascendingFunc": "(cellText1, cellText2) => Number(cellText1) - Number(cellText2)",
        "descendingFunc": "(cellText1, cellText2) => Number(cellText2) - Number(cellText1)"
  }}]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom type",
      "sorting": {
        "ascendingFunc": "(cellText1, cellText2) => Number(cellText1) - Number(cellText2)",
        "descendingFunc": "(cellText1, cellText2) => Number(cellText2) - Number(cellText1)"
  }}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom type"
  data='[
    ["Gravity", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `IconSettings` {#IconSettings}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`reusableIconName?: DEFAULT_COLUMN_TYPES`](#DEFAULT_COLUMN_TYPES), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `svgString?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `containerStyles?`: { <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`columnDropdown?: CSSStyle`](/docs/sharedTypes#CSSStyle), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`headerCorrections?: CSSStyle`](/docs/sharedTypes#CSSStyle), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}}

Defines column type icon properties. <br />
`reusableIconName` allows the icon to reuse of the existing default type icons. <br />
`svgString` is the full svg element string containing all DOM tags. Make sure to escape the quotes - change " to \" (An easy way to do this is to
stringify it using JSON.stringify()). If the string is defined directly in HTML (attribute), you will need to escape the first less than (<) character by replacing it with `&lt`. <br />
`containerStyles` allows the icon dimensions to be customised when displayed in the `columnDropdown` and in the header. By default, the `columnDropdown` dimension
properties are also used for the header however if they don't fit the `headerCorrections` object can be used to change them.

#### Example triangle icon

<TableContainer>
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom type',
        iconSettings: {
          svgString:
            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" height="10" width="16"> <polygon points="9,1 3,15 15,15" class="triangle" /></svg>',
          containerStyles: {
            dropdown: {marginLeft: '-2.5px', marginRight: '4px', marginTop: '2px'},
            headerCorrections: {marginTop: '-1px', marginLeft: '-2px'},
          },
        },
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom type'}
      ['Gravity', 'Diameter', 'Mass', 'Moons', 'Density'],
      [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
  {
    "name": "Custom type",
    "iconSettings": {
      "svgString": "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" xmlns:xlink=\"http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink\" height=\"10\" width=\"16\"> <polygon points=\"9,1 3,15 15,15\" class=\"triangle\" /></svg>",
      "containerStyles": {
        "dropdown": {"marginLeft": "-2.5px", "marginRight": "4px", "marginTop": "2px"},
        "headerCorrections": {"marginTop": "-1px", "marginLeft": "-2px"}
  }}}]'
  }'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
  {
    "name": "Custom type",
    "iconSettings": {
      "svgString": "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" xmlns:xlink=\"http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink\" height=\"10\" width=\"16\"> <polygon points=\"9,1 3,15 15,15\" class=\"triangle\" /></svg>",
      "containerStyles": {
        "dropdown": {"marginLeft": "-2.5px", "marginRight": "4px", "marginTop": "2px"},
        "headerCorrections": {"marginTop": "-1px", "marginLeft": "-2px"}
  }}}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom type"
  data='[
    ["Gravity", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    [9.8, 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    [3.7, 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    [23.1, 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    [9, 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    [11, 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

:::tip
Make sure the svg tag contains the xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" and xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" attributes. The backslash \\ syntax is only used when
setting `customColumnTypes` as an attribute (full string) to escape its quotes and is not needed when assigned as a property.

### `CellDropdown` {#CellDropdown}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`dropdownStyle?: CellDropdownStyle`](#CellDropdownStyle), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `optionStyle?: {textColor: string}`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; [`options?: SelectOptions|LabelOptions`](#SelectOptions), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `canAddMoreOptions?: boolean` <br />
- Default: { _canAddMoreOptions: true or if options property is set then false_ }

Dropdown customization properties for `select` and `label` properties in the [`ColumnType`](#ColumnType) object. <br />
`dropdownStyle` and `optionStyle` are used to apply specific dropdown styling aspects. <br />
`options` property defines custom options within the dropdown and uses the [`SelectOptions`](#SelectOptions) type to define individual options when
used for a `select` dropdown and [`LabelOptions`](#LabelOptions) if used for `label`. <br />
`canAddMoreOptions` controls whether new options can be added into the dropdown. If _false_ then column cell text that
is not in the _options_ array is automatically removed.

#### `CellDropdownStyle` {#CellDropdownStyle}

- Type: { <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `width?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `paddingTop?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `paddingBottom?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `marginTop?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `marginLeft?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `textAlign?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `border?: string`, <br />

Styling properties for the select and label dropdowns.

#### `SelectOptions` {#SelectOptions}

- Type: `string[]`<br />

#### Example for Select

<TableContainer minHeight="300">
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom select type',
        select: {
          dropdownStyle: {border: '0.5px solid #00000066'},
          optionStyle: {textColor: '#606060'},
          options: ['Elephant', 'Tiger', 'Giraffe'],
          canAddMoreOptions: false,
        },
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom select type'}
      ['Animal 1', 'Animal 2', 'Animal 3', 'Animal 4', 'Animal 5'],
      ['Elephant', 'Giraffe', 'Elephant', 'Giraffe', 'Tiger'],
      ['Tiger', 'Elephant', 'Tiger', 'Tiger', 'Giraffe'],
      ['Giraffe', 'Tiger', 'Invalid animal', 'Elephant', 'Invalid animal'],
      ['Invalid animal', 'Tiger', 'Giraffe', 'Invalid animal', 'Tiger'],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom select type",
      "select": {
        "dropdownStyle": {"border": "0.5px solid #00000066"},
        "optionStyle": {"textColor": "#606060"},
        "options": ["Elephant", "Tiger", "Giraffe"],
        "canAddMoreOptions": false
      }}]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom select type",
      "select": {
        "dropdownStyle": {"border": "0.5px solid #00000066"},
        "optionStyle": {"textColor": "#606060"},
        "options": ["Elephant", "Tiger", "Giraffe"],
        "canAddMoreOptions": false
    }}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom select type"
  data='[
    ["Animal 1", "Animal 2", "Animal 3", "Animal 4", "Animal 5"],
    ["Elephant", "Giraffe", "Elephant", "Giraffe", "Tiger"],
    ["Tiger", "Elephant", "Tiger", "Tiger", "Giraffe"],
    ["Giraffe", "Tiger", "Invalid animal", "Elephant", "Invalid animal"],
    ["Invalid animal", "Tiger", "Giraffe", "Invalid animal", "Tiger"]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

#### `LabelOptions` {#LabelOptions}

- Type: `{text: string; backgroundColor?: string}[]`<br />
- Default: _if backgroundColor is not provided then it is set to a random color_

#### Example for Label

<TableContainer minHeight="300">
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom label type',
        label: {
          options: [
            {text: 'Elephant', backgroundColor: '#4ddd3878'},
            {text: 'Tiger', backgroundColor: '#ff606082'},
            {text: 'Giraffe', backgroundColor: '#ff940f8f'},
          ],
          canAddMoreOptions: true,
        },
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom label type'}
      ['Animal 1', 'Animal 2', 'Animal 3', 'Animal 4', 'Animal 5'],
      ['Elephant', 'Giraffe', 'Elephant', 'Giraffe', 'Tiger'],
      ['Tiger', 'Elephant', 'Tiger', 'Tiger', 'Giraffe'],
      ['Giraffe', 'Tiger', 'Elephant', 'Elephant', 'Kangaroo'],
      ['Goose', 'Elephant', 'Giraffe', 'Whale', 'Tiger'],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom label type",
      "label": {
        "options": [{"text":"Elephant", "backgroundColor": "#4ddd3878"}, {"text":"Tiger", "backgroundColor": "#ff606082"}, {"text":"Giraffe", "backgroundColor": "#ff940f8f"}],
        "canAddMoreOptions": true
    }}]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom label type",
      "label": {
        "options": [{"text":"Elephant", "backgroundColor": "#4ddd3878"}, {"text":"Tiger", "backgroundColor": "#ff606082"}, {"text":"Giraffe", "backgroundColor": "#ff940f8f"}],
        "canAddMoreOptions": true
    }}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom label type"
  data='[
    ["Animal 1", "Animal 2", "Animal 3", "Animal 4", "Animal 5"],
    ["Elephant", "Giraffe", "Elephant", "Giraffe", "Tiger"],

    ["Giraffe", "Tiger", "Elephant", "Elephant", "Kangaroo"],
    ["Goose", "Elephant", "Giraffe", "Whale", "Tiger"]]'
  tableStyle='{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `Calendar` {#Calendar}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `toYMDFunc: (cellText: string) => YMDFormat`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; `fromYMDFunc: (YMD: YMDFormat) => string` <br />

Adds a hoverable calendar icon element to each data cell. When a cell is focused - a [date picker overlay](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/date)
is opened which the user can use to select the date they need. <br />
The `toYMDFunc` and `fromYMDFunc` functions are strictly used for converting cell text into a format ([`YMDFormat`](#YMDFormat)) the calendar API
accepts and back to the original format when a new date is chosen.

#### `YMDFormat` {#YMDFormat}

- Type: `[string, string, string, string?, string?, string?, string?]`

Date format used by the [`Date Picker`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/date). The tuple contents translate to
year / month / day (as digits e.g. '2022') and optionally hours / minutes / seconds / milliseconds (not used by the picker but may be required
for a custom [`Calendar`](#Calendar) type).

#### Example for custom d/m/y type

<TableContainer minHeight="258">
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom d/m/y type',
        calendar: {
          toYMDFunc:
            '(cellText) => { const integerArr = cellText.match(/\\d+/g); return [integerArr[2], integerArr[1], integerArr[0]]; }',
          fromYMDFunc: '(YMD) => { return [YMD[2], YMD[1], YMD[0]].join(`/`); }',
        },
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom d/m/y type'}
      ['Date 1', 'Date 2', 'Date 3', 'Date 4'],
      ['3/2/2052', '4/2/1993', '6/12/2012', '2/2/2012'],
      ['18/12/0001', '2/4/1689', '16/2/2029', '1/02/2004'],
      ['12/8/1943', '24/2/1992', '16/12/2022', '17/3/2023'],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom d/m/y type",
      "calendar": {
        "toYMDFunc": "(cellText) => { const integerArr = cellText.match(/\\d+/g); return [integerArr[2], integerArr[1], integerArr[0]]; }",
        "fromYMDFunc": "(YMD) => { return [YMD[2], YMD[1], YMD[0]].join(`/`); }"
    }}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom d/m/y type"
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom d/m/y type",
      "calendar": {
        "toYMDFunc": "(cellText) => { const integerArr = cellText.match(/\\d+/g); return [integerArr[2], integerArr[1], integerArr[0]]; }",
        "fromYMDFunc": "(YMD) => { return [YMD[2], YMD[1], YMD[0]].join(`/`); }"
    }}]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom d/m/y type"
  data='[
    ["Date 1", "Date 2", "Date 3", "Date 4"],
    ["3/2/2052", "4/2/1993", "6/12/2012", "2/2/2012"],
    ["18/12/0001", "2/4/1689", "16/2/2029", "1/02/2004"],
    ["12/8/1943", "24/2/1992", "16/12/2022", "17/3/2023"]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

:::danger
The above code serves as an example and the `toYMDFunc` function will break if cells do not adhere to the d/m/y format. It is advisable to
always analyze the incoming `cellText` value format and return a default value if it is not what was expected. Additionally, it is highly
recommended to supplement `calendar` with the use of [`textValidation`](#TextValidation) and [`customTextProcessing`](#CustomTextProcessing)
properties to make sure cell text is always in the correct format.

### `Checkbox` {#Checkbox}

- Type: `boolean`

Replaces cell text with a checkbox. <br />
This type automatically comes with a predefined [`customTextProcessing`](#CustomTextProcessing) property in the [`ColumnType`](#ColumnType) that
uses _""_, _"0"_, _"00"_ and _"false"_ values to represent the checkbox as unchecked and all the other values as checked. You can overwite it
with your own `changeTextFunc` function that would return a string of _"true"_ when the checkbox should be checked and _"false"_ when it should
be unchecked. <br />
The [`onCellUpdate`](/docs/events#onCellUpdate) and [`onDataUpdate`](/docs/events#onDataUpdate) properties will return string _"true"_ if the checkbox
is checked and _"false"_ if unchecked.

#### Example

<TableContainer minHeight="258">
    customColumnTypes={[
      {
        name: 'Custom checkbox type',
        checkbox: true,
      },
    defaultColumnTypeName={'Custom checkbox type'}
      ['Criteria 1', 'Criteria 2', 'Criteria 3', 'Criteria 4'],
      ['positive', 'true', 'positive', 'false'],
      ['true', 'false', '00', ''],
      ['', '0', 'positive', 'truthy'],

```html
<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom checkbox type",
      "checkbox": true
    }]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom checkbox type"
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  customColumnTypes='[
    {
      "name": "Custom checkbox type",
      "checkbox": true
    }]'
  defaultColumnTypeName="Custom checkbox type"
  data='[
    ["Criteria 1", "Criteria 2", "Criteria 3", "Criteria 4"],
    ["positive", "true", "positive", "false"],
    ["true", "false", "00", ""],
    ["", "0", "positive", "truthy"]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `DEFAULT_COLUMN_TYPES` {#DEFAULT_COLUMN_TYPES}

- Type: `"Text"` | `"Number"` | `"Currency"` | `"Date d-m-y"` | `"Date m-d-y"` | `"Checkbox"` | `"Select"` | `"Label"`

Default column type names.

# Data

Source: https://github.com/ovidijusparsiunas/active-table/blob/main/website/docs/docs/data.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

# Data

Properties related to data cells displayed in the table.

### `data` {#data}

- Type: `(string|number)[][]`

Header and data text to be displayed in the table. First array represents the header row, following arrays represent data rows.

#### Example

<TableContainer>

```html
<active-table
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `defaultText` {#defaultText}

- Type: `string|number`
- Default: _""_

Text that is displayed when a cell is empty or its type validation has failed. <br />

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    defaultText={'-'}
      ['', '', 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ['', '', 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ['', '', 1898, 79, 1326],
      ['', '', 568, 82, 687],
      ['', '', 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table defaultText="-"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  defaultText="-"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["", "", 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["", "", 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["", "", 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["", "", 568, 82, 687],
    ["", "", 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `isDefaultTextRemovable` {#isDefaultTextRemovable}

- Type: `boolean`
- Default: _true_

Removes default text when a cell containg one is focused.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    defaultText={'Click'}
    isDefaultTextRemovable={'true'}
      ['', '', 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ['', '', 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ['', '', 1898, 79, 1326],
      ['', '', 568, 82, 687],
      ['', '', 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table defaultText="Click" isDefaultTextRemovable="true"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  defaultText="Click"
  isDefaultTextRemovable="true"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["", "", 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["", "", 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["", "", 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["", "", 568, 82, 687],
    ["", "", 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `cellStyle` {#cellStyle}

- Type: { `CSSStyle` & `!minWidth` & `!maxWidth` & `!height` & `!minHeight` & `!maxHeight` }

Defines the default style for table cells. <br />
This object contais all `CSSStyle` properties except `minWidth`, `maxWidth`, `height`, `minHeight` and `maxHeight`. <br />
The `width` property supports _px_ and _%_ measurements, however when using _%_ - the [`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle) object should have its `width` property
set as otherwise the cells will not be able to calculate a relative width. Additionally, when [`cellStyle`](#cellStyle) - `width` and
[`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle) - `width` are defined and [`isColumnResizable`](/docs/column#isColumnResizable) is set to _true_, the [`cellStyle`](#cellStyle) - `width`
will be overriden to reach the set table `width`, hence to prevent this make sure to set [`isColumnResizable`](/docs/column#isColumnResizable) to _false_.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    cellStyle={{borderBottom: '1px solid black', borderRight: '1px solid black', backgroundColor: '#fafafa'}}

```html
<active-table
  cellStyle='{"borderBottom": "1px solid black", "borderRight": "1px solid black", "backgroundColor": "#fafafa"}'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  cellStyle='{"borderBottom": "1px solid black", "borderRight": "1px solid black", "backgroundColor": "#fafafa"}'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

:::info
If you wish to set the header cell style please use the [`headerStyles`](/docs/header#headerStyles) property and the style of the frame components (index, add new column,
new row) can be set via the [`frameComponentsStyles`](/docs/table#frameComponentsStyles) property.

### `rootCell` {#rootCell}

- Type: {`text: string`, [`styles: StatefulCSS`](/docs/sharedTypes#StatefulCSS)}
- Default: _{text: "+"}_

Configuration for the default cell when there is no data inside the table. <br />
`text` defines the content inside the cell. <br />
`styles` is used to define the cell's appearance for various mouse states. This is particularly useful for controlling the cell _width_ if you
have set a _width_ property inside [`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle) as the root cell will by default be stretched to match it (all documentation examples actually use
_width: 100%_ so you will notice that other examples' root cells match their original table widths). Outer styling such as _border_ and _boxShadow_ will
need to be controlled in [`tableStyle`](/docs/table#tableStyle).

#### Example

<TableContainer minHeight="110">
    rootCell={{text: 'Create', styles: {default: {width: '50px'}, hover: {backgroundColor: '#e0f1ff'}}}}

```html
<active-table
  rootCell='{"text": "Create", "styles": {"default": {"width": "50px"}, "hover": {"backgroundColor": "#e0f1ff"}}}'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  rootCell='{"text": "Create", "styles": {"default": {"width": "50px"}, "hover": {"backgroundColor": "#e0f1ff"}}}'
  tableStyle='{"width":"100%", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `isCellTextEditable` {#isCellTextEditable}

- Type: `boolean`
- Default: _true_

Controls if cell text can be edited for both data and header cells. This property is superseded by [`isHeaderTextEditable`](/docs/header#isHeaderTextEditable) for header cells.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    isCellTextEditable={false}

```html
<active-table isCellTextEditable="false"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  isCellTextEditable="false"
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `spellCheck` {#spellCheck}

- Type: `boolean`
- Default: _false_

Checks table text for spelling mistakes (based on the browser's language settings) and if found displays a curly red line under the errors.

#### Example

<TableContainer>
    spellCheck={true}
      ['Planetasdasd', 'Diamasdasdeter', 'Masssdfsdf', 'Mooffns', 'Denssdsdfdsfity'],
      ['asdasdasd', 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ['Msadasdars', 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ['Jupitar', 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      ['asudhasd', 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      ['saiuhfjduidshfuis', 49528, 102, 14, 1638],

```html
<active-table spellCheck="true"></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->

<active-table
  spellCheck="true"
  data='[
    ["Planetasdasd", "Diamasdasdeter", "Masssdfsdf", "Mooffns", "Denssdsdfdsfity"],
    ["asdasdasd", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Msadasdars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupitar", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["asudhasd", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["saiuhfjduidshfuis", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

:::caution
This is a browser dependent feature that may be handled differently depending on the browser you are using.

# Events

Source: https://github.com/ovidijusparsiunas/active-table/blob/main/website/docs/docs/events.mdx

sidebar_position: 12

# Events

Events can be observed in two ways, either by assigning a function to a property or by listening to custom events fired from the element.

:::info
Take care not to re-render the component when using event information to update parent state.

### `onCellUpdate` {#onCellUpdate}

- Function: (`cellUpdate: Body`) => `void`
- Event: `cell-update`
- Body: { <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`text: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`rowIndex: number`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`columnIndex: number`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`updateType: "add"|"update"|"remove"` <br />

Triggered when any data within the table has changed. Both `rowIndex` and `columnIndex` begin at _0_
where it is the header row for `rowIndex` and the left-most column for `columnIndex`.

#### Example

import TableContainerEvents from '@site/src/components/table/tableContainerEvents';

<TableContainerEvents propertyName={"onCellUpdate"}>
      ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
      ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]}
    tableStyle={{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}}

</TableContainerEvents>

<TabItem value="js" label="Function">

```javascript
tableElementRef.onCellUpdate = (cellUpdate) => { console.log(cellUpdate); });
```

<TabItem value="py" label="Event">

```javascript
// This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples)

tableElementRef.addEventListener('cell-update', (cellUpdate) => {
  console.log(cellUpdate.detail);
});
```

### `onDataUpdate` {#onDataUpdate}

- Function: (`dataUpdate: Body`) => `void`
- Event: `data-update`
- Body: `(string|number)[][]`

Similarly to [`onCellUpdate`](#onCellUpdate) this is triggered when any cell is updated - however this property returns the full table data in a 2D array instead.

#### Example

<TableContainerEvents propertyName={"onDataUpdate"}>
      ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
      ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]}
    tableStyle={{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}}

</TableContainerEvents>

<TabItem value="js" label="Function">

```javascript
tableElementRef.onDataUpdate = (dataUpdate) => {
  console.log(dataUpdate);
};
```

<TabItem value="py" label="Event">

```javascript
// This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples)

tableElementRef.addEventListener('data-update', (dataUpdate) => {
  console.log(dataUpdate.detail);
});
```

### `onColumnsUpdate` {#onColumnsUpdate}

- Function: (`columnsUpdate: Body`) => `void`
- Event: `columns-update`
- Body: [`ColumnsDetails`](/docs/sharedTypes#ColumnsDetails)

Triggered when any of the properties inside the [`ColumnsDetails`](/docs/sharedTypes#ColumnsDetails) object are updated. This is particularly useful if the user has made changes to columns and you want to recreate them
in the next session on the initial load.

#### Example

<TableContainerEvents propertyName={"onColumnsUpdate"}>
      ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
      ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]}
    tableStyle={{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}}

</TableContainerEvents>

<TabItem value="js" label="Function">

```javascript
tableElementRef.onColumnsUpdate = (columnsUpdate) => {
  console.log(columnsUpdate);
};
```

<TabItem value="py" label="Event">

```javascript
// This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples)

tableElementRef.addEventListener('columns-update', (columnsUpdate) => {
  console.log(columnsUpdate.detail);
});
```

### `onRender` {#onRender}

- Function: () => `void`
- Event: `render`

Triggered when the component has finished rendering on the browser's window.

#### Example

<TableContainerEvents propertyName={"onRender"}>
      ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
      ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]}
    tableStyle={{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}}

</TableContainerEvents>

<TabItem value="js" label="Function">

```javascript
tableElementRef.onRender = () => {
  console.log('Finished rendering');
};
```

<TabItem value="py" label="Event">

```javascript
// This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples)

tableElementRef.addEventListener('render', () => {
  console.log('Finished rendering');
});
```

# Files

Source: https://github.com/ovidijusparsiunas/active-table/blob/main/website/docs/docs/files.mdx

sidebar_position: 10

# Files

Active Table supports the following file formats: `csv`, `xls`, `xlsx`, `ods`, `txt`. You can import or export files via the use of [buttons](#FileButton),
[methods](/docs/methods#importCSV) or using [drag and drop](#DragAndDrop). You can additionally copy data from an external spreadsheet and paste it into the table directly.

:::info
`csv` is supported natively, however if you are using any of the other file formats - you will need to add the [`xlsx`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/xlsx) module
into your project. Please see examples [here](../examples/files).

### `files` {#files}

- Type: {[`buttons?: FileButton[]`](#FileButton), [`dragAndDrop: boolean | DragAndDrop`](#DragAndDrop)}
- Default: _{buttons: [], dragAndDrop: false}_

`buttons` is an array containing button definitions. <br />
`dragAndDrop` is used to configure the drag and drop functionality. If any of the `buttons` use the [`import`](#FileButton) property, it automatically defaults to _true_. <br />

<BrowserOnly>{() => require('@site/src/components/externalModules/externalModules').importXLSX()}</BrowserOnly>

<TableContainer minHeight="381">
    files={{buttons: [{import: true}, {export: true}], dragAndDrop: true}}

```html
<active-table files='{"buttons": [{"import": true}, {"export": true}], "dragAndDrop": true}'></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->
<!-- If you are using file formats other than csv, import the 'xlsx' module (see Files Examples) -->

<active-table
  files='{"buttons": [{"import": true}, {"export": true}], "dragAndDrop": true}'
  data='[
      ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
      ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
      ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
      ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
      ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
      ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

## Types

Object types for properties inside [`files`](#files):

### `FileButton` {#FileButton}

  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[`import: true | ImportOptions`](#ImportOptions), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[`export: true | ExportOptions`](#ExportOptions), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`text?: string`, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[`styles?: StatefulCSS`](/docs/sharedTypes#StatefulCSS), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[`position?: OuterContentPosition`](/docs/sharedTypes#OuterContentPosition), <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`order?: number` <br />
- Default: {<br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;_text: "Import"|"Export"_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;_position: "bottom-left"_, <br />
  &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;_order: 0_ <br />

This object requires either the `import` or `export` properties to be defined. <br />
`text` is the text that is displayed on the button. <br />
`styles` is the definition of button style for various mouse events. <br />
`position` is the location of the button. <br />
`order` is the order of the button when multiple other components are also placed in the same position.

#### Example

<TableContainer minHeight="382">
    files={{
      buttons: [
        {
          import: true,
          styles: {
            default: {
              backgroundColor: '#46acff',
              height: '19px',
              padding: '7px 14px',
              color: 'white',
              border: 'unset',
            },
            hover: {backgroundColor: '#2b9cf8'},
            click: {backgroundColor: '#198eef'},
          },
          text: 'Import File',
          position: 'top-left',
          order: 1,
        },
        {
          export: true,
          styles: {
            default: {
              backgroundColor: '#46acff',
              height: '19px',
              padding: '7px 14px',
              color: 'white',
              border: 'unset',
            },
            hover: {backgroundColor: '#2b9cf8'},
            click: {backgroundColor: '#198eef'},
          },
          text: 'Export File',
          position: 'top-left',
          order: 0,
        },
      ],
    }}

```html
<active-table
  files='{
    "buttons": [
      {
        "import": true,
        "styles": {
          "default": {
            "backgroundColor": "#46acff", "height": "19px", "padding": "7px 14px", "color": "white", "border": "unset"
          },
          "hover": {"backgroundColor": "#2b9cf8"}, "click": {"backgroundColor": "#198eef"}
        },
        "text": "Import File",
        "position": "top-left",
        "order": 1
      },
      {
        "export": true,
        "styles": {
          "default": {
            "backgroundColor": "#46acff", "height": "19px", "padding": "7px 14px", "color": "white", "border": "unset"
          },
          "hover": {"backgroundColor": "#2b9cf8"}, "click": {"backgroundColor": "#198eef"}
        },
        "text": "Export File",
        "position": "top-left",
        "order": 0
      }
    ]}'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->
<!-- If you are using file formats other than csv, import the 'xlsx' module (see Files Examples) -->

<active-table
  files='{
    "buttons": [
      {
        "import": true,
        "styles": {
          "default": {
            "backgroundColor": "#46acff", "height": "19px", "padding": "7px 14px", "color": "white", "border": "unset"
          },
          "hover": {"backgroundColor": "#2b9cf8"}, "click": {"backgroundColor": "#198eef"}
        },
        "text": "Import File",
        "position": "top-left",
        "order": 1
      },
      {
        "export": true,
        "styles": {
          "default": {
            "backgroundColor": "#46acff", "height": "19px", "padding": "7px 14px", "color": "white", "border": "unset"
          },
          "hover": {"backgroundColor": "#2b9cf8"}, "click": {"backgroundColor": "#198eef"}
        },
        "text": "Export File",
        "position": "top-left",
        "order": 0
      }
  ]}'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `DragAndDrop` {#DragAndDrop}

- Type: {[`overlayStyle?: CSSStyle`](/docs/sharedTypes#CSSStyle)} & [`ImportOptions`](#ImportOptions)

Configuration for the drag and drop functionality. <br />
`overlayStyle` is used to customise the overlay element that is displayed when a file is dragged over the table. <br />
If the [`formats`](#ImportOptions) array inside `ImportOptions` is not set or is empty, it will automatically use all formats defined in the import buttons
(if there are two import buttons where one accepts _"csv"_ and another accepts _"xlsx"_, the result will be _["csv", "xlsx"]_), however if there
are no import buttons this property will be set to _["csv"]_.

#### Example

<TableContainer minHeight="343">
    files={{
      dragAndDrop: {
        overlayStyle: {backgroundColor: '#80ff704d', border: '5px dashed #52c360'},
        formats: ['csv', 'xlsx'],
        overwriteOptions: {importRowStartIndex: 1, tableRowStartIndex: 1},
      },
    }}

```html
<active-table
  files='{
    "dragAndDrop": {
      "overlayStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#80ff704d", "border": "5px dashed #52c360"},
      "formats": ["csv", "xlsx"],
      "overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 1, "tableRowStartIndex": 1}
  }}'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->
<!-- If you are using file formats other than csv (like in the example), import the 'xlsx' module (see Files Examples) -->

<active-table
  files='{
    "dragAndDrop": {
      "overlayStyle": {"backgroundColor": "#80ff704d", "border": "5px dashed #52c360"},
      "formats": ["csv", "xlsx"],
      "overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 1, "tableRowStartIndex": 1}
  }}'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

:::info
The overlay will appear for any file format as the component cannot inspect the file that is being dragged, but it will not process
file formats that are not in the [`formats`](#ImportOptions) array after they are dropped.

### `ImportOptions` {#ImportOptions}

- Type: {[`formats?: FileFormat[]`](#FileFormat), [`overwriteOptions?: ImportOverwriteOptions`](#ImportOverwriteOptions)}
- Default: {_formats: ["csv"]_}

Configuration for the importable files. <br />
`formats` are file extensions that are allowed to be imported. If the array is not set or is empty - it will default to _["csv"]_. <br />
`overwriteOptions` defines the content that the imported file will overwrite.

#### Example

<TableContainer minHeight="381">
    files={{
      buttons: [
        {
          import: {
            formats: ['csv', 'ods', 'txt'],
            overwriteOptions: {
              importRowStartIndex: 1,
              tableRowStartIndex: 1,
            },
          },
          text: 'Import CSV ODS TXT',
        },
        {
          import: {
            formats: ['xls', 'xlsx'],
            overwriteOptions: {
              importRowStartIndex: 2,
              tableRowStartIndex: 2,
            },
          },
          text: 'Import XLS XLSX',
        },
      ],
    }}

```html
<active-table
  files='{
    "buttons": [
      {
        "import": {
          "formats": ["csv", "ods", "txt"],
          "overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 1, "tableRowStartIndex": 1}
        }
      },
      {
        "import": {
          "formats": ["xls", "xlsx"],
          "overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 2, "tableRowStartIndex": 2}
        }
      }
  ]}'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->
<!-- If you are using file formats other than csv (like in the example), import the 'xlsx' module (see Files Examples) -->

<active-table
  files='{
    "buttons": [
      {
        "import": {
          "formats": ["csv", "ods", "txt"],
          "overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 1, "tableRowStartIndex": 1}
        },
        "text": "Import CSV ODS TXT"
      },
      {
        "import": {
          "formats": ["xls", "xlsx"],
          "overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 2, "tableRowStartIndex": 2}
        },
        "text": "Import XLS XLSX"
      }
  ]}'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `ImportOverwriteOptions` {#ImportOverwriteOptions}

- Type: {`importRowStartIndex?: number`, `tableRowStartIndex?: number`}
- Default: {_importRowStartIndex: 0_, _tableRowStartIndex: 0_}

Configuration for defining which imported file's rows will be used to overwrite which table rows. Both properties
use zero based indexes where the first row is represented by 0. <br />
`importRowStartIndex` property is the imported file's starting row index that will be used to overwrite the table. E.g. a value of _1_
indicates that it will only use rows below the header. <br />
`tableRowStartIndex` property marks the starting row of the data that will be completely removed and overwritten by the imported table rows. E.g. a value of _1_
will overwrite all of the rows below the header row. Use a value of _-1_ to append the incoming table rows after the last existing row of the table. <br />

#### Example

<TableContainer minHeight="381">
    files={{buttons: [{import: {overwriteOptions: {importRowStartIndex: 1, tableRowStartIndex: -1}}}]}}

```html
<active-table
  files='{"buttons": [{"import": {"overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 1, "tableRowStartIndex": -1}}}]}'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->
<!-- If you are using file formats other than csv (like in the example), import the 'xlsx' module (see Files Examples) -->

<active-table
  files='{"buttons": [{"import": {"overwriteOptions": {"importRowStartIndex": 1, "tableRowStartIndex": -1}}}]}'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `ExportOptions` {#ExportOptions}

- Type: {fileName?: string, [`formats?: FileFormat[]`](#FileFormat)}
- Default: _{fileName: "table_data", format: ["csv"]}_

Configuration for the exported `fileName` and the available `formats` that it can be exported with. <br />
When more than one format is defined - the button will use a dropdown to list each option.

#### Example

<TableContainer minHeight="381">
    files={{
      buttons: [
        {export: {fileName: 'example_csv', formats: ['csv']}, text: 'Export CSV'},
        {export: {fileName: 'example_xls', formats: ['xls']}, text: 'Export XLS'},
        {export: {fileName: 'example_xlsx', formats: ['xlsx']}, text: 'Export XLSX'},
        {export: {fileName: 'example_ods', formats: ['ods']}, text: 'Export ODS'},
        {export: {fileName: 'example_txt', formats: ['txt']}, text: 'Export TXT'},
        {export: {fileName: 'example', formats: ['csv', 'xls', 'xlsx', 'ods', 'txt']}, text: 'Export'},
      ],
    }}

```html
<active-table
  files='{
    "buttons": [
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_csv", "formats": ["csv"]}},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_xls", "formats": ["xls"]}},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_xlsx", "formats": ["xlsx"]}},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_ods", "formats": ["ods"]}},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_txt", "formats": ["txt"]}},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example", "formats": ["csv", "xls", "xlsx", "ods", "txt"]}}
  ]}'
></active-table>
```

```html
<!-- This example is for Vanilla JS and should be tailored to your framework (see Examples) -->
<!-- If you are using file formats other than csv (like in the example), import the 'xlsx' module (see Files Examples) -->

<active-table
  files='{
    "buttons": [
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_csv", "formats": ["csv"]}, "text": "Export CSV"},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_xls", "formats": ["xls"]}, "text": "Export XLS"},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_xlsx", "formats": ["xlsx"]}, "text": "Export XLSX"},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_ods", "formats": ["ods"]}, "text": "Export ODS"},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example_txt", "formats": ["txt"]}, "text": "Export TXT"},
      {"export": {"fileName": "example", "formats": ["csv", "xls", "xlsx", "ods", "txt"]}}
  ]}'
  data='[
    ["Planet", "Diameter", "Mass", "Moons", "Density"],
    ["Earth", 12756, 5.97, 1, 5514],
    ["Mars", 6792, 0.642, 2, 3934],
    ["Jupiter", 142984, 1898, 79, 1326],
    ["Saturn", 120536, 568, 82, 687],
    ["Neptune", 49528, 102, 14, 1638]]'
  tableStyle='{"width":"100%", "boxShadow": "rgb(172 172 172 / 17%) 0px 0.5px 1px 0px", "borderRadius":"2px"}'
></active-table>
```

### `FileFormat` {#FileFormat}

- Type: `"csv"` | `"xls"` | `"xlsx"` | `"ods"` | `"txt"`

File formats that can be imported into and exported out of Active Table.
